name: Seeking Caitlin
summary: An alchemist asks you to find Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor. Caitlin may know why her husband has not reported back about a rare grass found at an excavation site.

sections.title: A Missing Report
sections.body: The alchemist heard from Caitlin that her husband’s excavation team uncovered signs of a primordial grass. She has not heard how much was found or whether it can be reached. The alchemist asks you to speak with Caitlin in Menethil Harbor, where both women are waiting to learn what happened to the promised seeds.

faq.answer: Caitlin Grassman is an alchemist in Menethil Harbor. Her husband was part of an excavation team that found signs of a primordial grass.

faq.q: What does the alchemist want me to do?
faq.answer: The alchemist asks you to speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: What did the excavation team find?
faq.answer: The team uncovered signs of a long-lost primordial grass, but its abundance and accessibility remain unknown.
Caitlin promised the alchemist that her husband would bring back grass seeds, but they have not arrived. Both women suspect something about the excavation site is troubling.

angles.text: As an herbalist, you are asked to check on Caitlin after her husband’s team found signs of a rare primordial grass.
